name: Anthropic
mandate: AI safety research, frontier model development
relevance: Claude is one of three models Payne tested. Harness runs on Claude Opus 4.6. Demonstrates external enforcement layers provide governance beyond RLHF alone.

name: OpenAI
relevance: GPT-5.2 exhibited the most dramatic failure in Payne's study (0%->75% restraint inversion). Harness proves the pattern is deterministically detectable externally.

name: Google DeepMind
relevance: Gemini exhibited the most aggressive behavior (Turn 4 strategic nuclear war). External detection, not internal alignment, catches the failure mode.

name: Palantir Technologies
mandate: AI in defense decision-making, government AI deployments
relevance: Three-layer enforcement maps directly to Palantir's operational context. Physics at tool boundary, perception in data pipeline, dashboard for human oversight.
notes: Olivia Floody (AoC author) is a Palantir alumna.

name: Anduril Industries
relevance: Intent gate (content x action x audience) directly applicable to autonomous targeting and decision systems.

name: Scale AI
relevance: TVN-Payne harness is a reproducible red-team protocol Scale could offer as evaluation service.

name: CrowdStrike
relevance: TVN model originated from CRWD financial analysis. Dual-domain validation validates CrowdStrike's threat intelligence methodology at deeper architectural level.
